faq.q: What is a titanium uhp hydrogen tube fitting?
faq.a: A titanium uhp hydrogen tube fitting is a precision-machined hydrogen hardware component used in ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium uhp hydrogen tube fitting?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium uhp hydrogen tube fitting manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium uhp hydrogen tube fitting?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium uhp hydrogen tube fitting?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
